WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.434447 42.723028)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.434447 42.723028)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'living_street'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.434447 42.723028)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

```sql
WITH dyken_pond AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.434447, 42.723028), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
closest_road AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.geometry,
    ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, dyken_pond.geom) AS distance_m
  FROM roads r, dyken_pond
  WHERE r.highway = 'living_street'
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, dyken_pond.geom, 10000) -- 10 km buffer to limit search
  ORDER BY distance_m
  LIMIT 1
),
road_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(r.rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r, closest_road
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, closest_road.geometry::geometry)
),
slope_along_road AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(road_profile.rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
)
SELECT 
  'Dyken Pond Environmental Education Center' AS feature1,
  'living_street' AS feature2,
  ROUND(closest_road.distance_m::numeric, 2) AS distance_meters,
  ROUND(ST_Stats(slope_along_road.slope_rast).mean::numeric, 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM closest_road, slope_along_road;
```
